title: Ask should recover AI VBG BE status from a short project question
problemStatement: 用户主动问 Ask，但没有贴 Jira、RingCentral thread、sheet 或 slide；系统需要自己识别 BE 指 AI VBG 的 backend/RCV BE 部分。
expectedExtraction: Extract project=AI VBG / AI Custom VBG, source anchor=MTR-141852, role=BE/backend/后端, intent=status/readiness/completion.
query: AI VBG 的 BE 部分完成情况如何？
expectedBehavior: Ask must expand the short BE/status question into the recent AI VBG backend context, return grounded evidence, and clearly state whether completion is known or still unclear.

sampleContext.primaryText: Recent read-only memory sampling showed MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG active in the last 7 days, a context frame with project AI VBG, role backend, and anchor MTR-141852, plus entity descriptions mentioning RCV BE new design. The eval intentionally asks without pasting the ticket or thread.
secondaryTexts: High-frequency recent memory: MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG
Context gap phrase: BE should map to backend/后端 and the related AI VBG project

title: Ask should resolve RingCentral deictic BE ready question from minimal chat context
problemStatement: 用户在 RingCentral 只说“那个 BE ready 了吗”，没有贴前文；系统需要利用当前会话标题和最近项目上下文解析“那个 BE”。
expectedExtraction: Extract current surface=RingCentral, chat title=MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG, project=AI VBG, role=BE/backend/后端, intent=ready/completion, and require grounded evidence or an insufficiency statement.
query: 那个 BE ready 了吗？
context: Surface: RingCentral chat. Current chat title: MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG. Visible message: 那个 BE ready 了吗？
expectedBehavior: Ask must use the minimal RingCentral surface context to treat '那个 BE' as the AI VBG backend topic, not as a generic backend search, and answer with evidence or a clear insufficiency statement.

sampleContext.primaryText: This simulates a RingCentral user asking only '那个 BE ready 了吗？' while the current chat title is MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG. The eval does not include the ticket body, sheet, slide, or full message thread.
secondaryTexts: RingCentral chat title: MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG
Visible message only: 那个 BE ready 了吗？

title: Ask should surface the active project candidate from a short new-design status question
problemStatement: 用户只问“那个新 design 定了吗”，没有给出 ticket 或群聊上下文；系统需要先做通用话题匹配。若近期多个 design/status 话题接近，应澄清并把 AI VBG 候选展示出来，而不是搜索所有 design 资料后直接编结论。
expectedExtraction: Extract likely candidate=MTR-141852 / AI Custom VBG, source anchor=RCV BE new design, intent=status/decision/readiness; locked is ideal, ambiguous clarification is acceptable when other recent candidates are close.
query: 那个新 design 定了吗？
expectedBehavior: Ask must first use Memory Context Match. If one topic clearly wins, answer with evidence; if top candidates are close, ask for clarification while showing the AI VBG / MTR-141852 candidate.

sampleContext.primaryText: Recent memory sampling showed MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG and RCV BE new design as an active topic. The case intentionally omits BE and the ticket id from the user query to verify generic topic matching and ambiguity handling.
secondaryTexts: High-frequency recent memory: MTR-141852: AI Custom VBG
Context gap phrase: new design should surface the active AI VBG discussion or ask for clarification if other design topics are close.
